questions.response: Fixed Deposit (FD) is a safe investment where you deposit money for a fixed period at guaranteed interest. FD & RD Deposits require: Full Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Address, Pincode, Deposit Amount, Tenure, Interest Payout, Bank Account, and IFSC Code.
Recurring Deposit (RD) lets you invest fixed amounts regularly. Perfect for savings discipline. Same requirements as FD. Apply via Services > Savings Services > FD & RD Deposits.

Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) is for ages 60+. Required: Full Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Address, Pincode, Deposit Amount, Tenure, Bank Account, IFSC, Nominee Name, Nominee Relationship, and Age proof.

Goal Based Investments help save for specific targets: education, retirement, home. Required: Personal info, Financial details (income, EMI, credit score), Goal name, target amount, time horizon, and risk tolerance. Apply via Services > Savings Services.

Tax Saving Investments reduce taxable income (80C deduction). Includes ELSS and PPF-like products. Required: Personal info, Financial details, Investment amount, tax regime, and PAN number. Save taxes while investing!
Interest rates vary by product and tenure. Check Services section for current rates. Generally: FDs offer 5-7%, RDs 4-6%, Goal-based 6-8%, Tax-saving 6-9% depending on partner banks.
Maturity amount = Principal + Interest earned. You receive it on maturity date. Use our Returns Calculator (Services section) to calculate exact amount for your investment.
Nominee inherits your savings if something happens to you. Provide Nominee Name and Relationship when applying. Required for SCSS and optional for others.
Lock-in periods vary: FD usually 1-5 years, SCSS 5 years, ELSS 3 years, PPF 15 years. Early withdrawal may have penalties. Check scheme details before applying.
Savings products (FD, RD) are safer with fixed returns. Goal-based investments offer growth potential. Tax-saving products combine both. Choose based on your risk tolerance and timeline.
